capability_verification.note: Setup verifies the running distribution against one named capability profile before it writes or installs anything. Verification is a Consumer of the capability manifest, not a Continuation operation, so it adds no command to the contract's namespace. The distribution running setup is the distribution being verified, which is how the selection is made without committing a host-specific executable path or a family-member choice. `report` is the second profile: a distribution that cannot resolve an operator authority or does not advertise the mode fails closed here rather than during a Run. `execute-frontier` is the third profile and is family-wide as of the #267 rollout gate: the Python Runner (#264), the shell Orchestrator (#265) and the PowerShell Orchestrator (#266) each dispatch a serial fixed frontier, so every member declares it. `profile_distributions` stays an explicit axis rather than being collapsed into the family list, because it is what a narrower profile would be recorded in again and what makes a member judged against a profile it has not implemented a failure rather than an assumption.
